method: Visually inspected faces_sheet.png, eyes_sheet.png, all seven initial generated eye sheets and both accepted v2 eye sheets.
Independently reproduced source-to-reference rigid registration and renderer min-scale math.
Measured actual generated rest-cel ink pixels, not just crop rectangles, after the renderer transform.
Original bounds use dense source contour points plus stroke radius. Curved SVG smoothing can move extrema slightly.
Ratio severity is diagnostic: high means below 0.8 or above 1.25 on either dimension, or >0.1 normalized source-reference RMS. It is not a perceptual quality score.
Low severity does not mean exact identity match. All 30 source shapes are replaced by seven generated representatives at rest.

findings.detail: Every eye uses its generated family representative at rest; grouping was broad motion compatibility, not shape equivalence.
findings.fix: Keep canonical source art for rest and settled; preserve exact slot placement. Use generated cels only within blink, with per-part retargeting.

findings.detail: Uniform scale uses rotated master rectangle bounds. Rotating a mostly empty rectangle overestimates ink extents and can substantially shrink both dimensions.
findings.fix: Fit measured ink support or explicit family basis, not rotated crop rectangles. Enforce source width and endpoints in per-part blink retargeting.

findings.detail: rigAt selects previous before half and current after half. Blink only changes lid pose; mouth, tears, eye slots and sizes jump at the midpoint.
findings.fix: Interpolate shared layer placement and use opacity transitions for incompatible topology. Keep speech timeline independent of expression changes.

findings.issue: Preview and production speaking geometry disagree
findings.detail: Preview clamps mouth width and omits rotation/mirror; production uses raw width, rotation/mirror and face fitting. Face 37 uses different mouth family. Faces 12 and 35 have no mouth: preview fabricates one, production cannot speak visually.
findings.fix: One shared renderer and explicit per-face speech policy.

recommendation: Preserve exact canonical artwork outside blink; use reusable transitions on layer transforms and opacity, with generated intermediate cels retargeted per source part. The model should select semantic face intents and duration, not part IDs or frame indices.
